name: Maronroman
source:
Marron, a young girl living in the fantasy kingdom of Amestaria, lives a peaceful life surrounded by magic and mystery.
But one day, when she touches a mysterious white rabbit named Alice in the forest, she suddenly finds herself transported to Japan!

There, she meets a Japanese boy named Ryota Shigure, and together they set out on a journey to experience the wonders of Japan’s beautiful culture.
Will you join them on their enchanting one-day adventure?

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/marronroman-switch/]Nintendo Store[/url]]
